title: [factory-setup-agent] factory-setup-trial.yml nests a round's stubs under an existing .factory/sandbox/stubs
body:
Found while running the sandbox amendment episode for inadequacy report `fe3d81f91d435c56`. It does not block that amendment — the manifest works around it — but the workaround should not be necessary, and the next person to ship files in `stubs/` will hit it without the workaround.

## What happens

`.github/workflows/factory-setup-trial.yml`, "Place the round's stubs":

```bash
if [ -d "$DESIGN/stubs" ]; then mkdir -p .factory/sandbox && cp -R "$DESIGN/stubs" .factory/sandbox/stubs; fi
```

`cp -R src dst` copies *into* `dst` when `dst` already exists as a directory. The freeze step in `factory-setup.yml` knows this and guards against it:

```bash
if [ -d "$design/stubs" ]; then rm -rf .factory/sandbox/stubs; cp -R "$design/stubs" .factory/sandbox/stubs; fi
```

The trial step has no `rm -rf`.

## Why it matters

Today `bsf-fixtures/py-api` has no `.factory/sandbox/stubs` in the repo, so the trial places a round's stubs flat and everything works. Once any setup round merges one — which this amendment does — the directory exists on the branch the trial checks out, and from then on:

- the round's fresh copy lands at `.factory/sandbox/stubs/stubs/...`;
- the previously merged copy stays at `.factory/sandbox/stubs/...`;
- a `run` or `start` command written against the flat path therefore runs the *old* files.

A later round would be trialled against stubs it did not write, its edits would appear to have no effect, and nothing in the trial output would say so. The measured tier would be real but would describe the wrong code — the quiet failure mode, not the loud one.

## Suggested fix

Make the trial step match the freeze step:

```bash
if [ -d "$DESIGN/stubs" ]; then
  mkdir -p .factory/sandbox
  rm -rf .factory/sandbox/stubs
  cp -R "$DESIGN/stubs" .factory/sandbox/stubs
fi
```

A round's design should fully replace whatever is on the branch, the same way the freeze does. `.github/workflows/factory-setup-trial.yml` is a plain workflow, not a compiled `.lock.yml`, so this is a one-hunk change.

## Workaround currently in the manifest

Until that lands, `commands.run` and `commands.seed` in the amended `.factory/sandbox/manifest.json` prefer the nested path when it exists:

```bash
D=.factory/sandbox/stubs/sandbox-admin
if [ -d .factory/sandbox/stubs/stubs/sandbox-admin ]; then D=.factory/sandbox/stubs/stubs/sandbox-admin; fi
```

Both layouts were tested during the amendment episode and each resolves to the copy it should. The workaround can be dropped from the manifest once the trial step replaces rather than nests.

## Verifying the fix

Merge the amendment first (so `.factory/sandbox/stubs` exists on the default branch), then run `factory-setup` with any amendment input and confirm the trial's workspace has no `.factory/sandbox/stubs/stubs` directory.
